discourse.title: The Avatar of Love
discourse.excerpt: It has been said: "Love is God. Love pervades the Cosmos." Hence, one should not view the world from a worldly point of view. It should be viewed through the eyes of love. Embodiments of Divine Love! All the festivals of Bharatiyas have been designed to promote Divine love among the people.
discourse.theme: Love is God; view the world through the eyes of love.

reflection: Someone really tested my patience today — how do I respond? Swami's answer is a lens, not a lecture: look again, through the eyes of love. The same person seen through irritation versus through love is a different person. Try it once today — on the hardest person — and watch the world change its face.
